placements.why: The directives to forget a specific decision and remove all knowledge of a migration name an organizational category — governance over what knowledge persists — that nothing in the empty strata covers.
placements.title: From retention by default to commanded erasure
placements.frame: What authority structures and practices govern which knowledge the organization retains, discards, or actively erases?

placements.title: Authority to forget
placements.frame: Who commands what the organization remembers or forgets, and is that authority enacted through bare imperative rather than persuasion on the merits?
placements.why: Both segments are unhedged imperatives directing the erasure of specific organizational knowledge artifacts — a decision and a migration — enacting unilateral authority over the epistemic record. This thematic subject (authority over organizational memory performed as command) will accumulate support from future envelopes.
